author: K. R. Stuart
title: How many Hispanic students were enrolled in Edgar County districts in 2023-24 school year?
text:
Mary Morgan Ryan, Superintendent at Paris Union School District 95 | https://cdn6.creativecirclemedia.com/
Mary Morgan Ryan, Superintendent at Paris Union School District 95 | https://cdn6.creativecirclemedia.com/
Illinois State Board of Education.
Data showed that Hispanic students made up 1.9% of the 2,626 students in the county. They were the second most represented ethnicity.
Among the six districts in Edgar County, Paris-Union School District 95 recorded the highest enrollment of Hispanic students in the 2023-24 school year, with a total of 37 students.
The main offices of all districts mentioned in the story are located in cities associated with Edgar County.
Illinois allocated $8.6 billion to K-12 education in its 2025 budget—a $350 million increase over FY 2024, meeting the minimum required under the state’s school funding formula.
As of the 2023-24 school year, Illinois public schools enrolled approximately 1.85 million students across nearly 4,000 schools. There was roughly one teacher for every 15 students, slightly better than the national average of 1:16.
District | Hispanic Student Enrollment Percentage | Total enrollment |
---|---|---|
Paris-Union School District 95 | 4.3% | 868 |
Shiloh Community Unit School District 1 | 3.4% | 358 |
